name: Axis Solutions Limited
about: Axis Solutions Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of engineering products for oil and gas, refinery, cement, and water pollution equipment industries in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Automation and Digitalisation, Water, and Industrial Engineering & Systems. The company also offers analyzer shelters, steam and water analysis systems, gas analysis system control panels, and automation system products; complex measurement and analytical technology; automation, control, communication, IIOT products and systems; and industrial automation, instrumentation, and control system products and solutions for oil and gas, petrochemical, refinery, telecom, cement, power plants, power generation, equipment manufacturers, and other engineering industries. Axis Solutions Limited was formerly known as Asya Infosoft Limited and changed its name to Axis Solutions Limited in March 2025. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
